user.title: Connect to OpenClaw
user.description: Enter your OpenClaw gateway details. Run `openclaw gateway status` to find the host and token.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of your OpenClaw gateway — e.g. 192.168.1.50
data_description.token: Auth token from your gateway config. Leave blank if auth is disabled.
data_description.session_key: Leave blank to auto-create a 'homeassistant' session, or paste an existing session key.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure OpenClaw
reconfigure.description: Update the gateway host, port, token, or session key.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of your OpenClaw gateway
data_description.token: Auth token from your gateway config. Leave blank if auth is disabled.
data_description.session_key: The session key Home Assistant should route messages to.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the OpenClaw gateway — check the host/port and ensure OpenClaw is running.
error.unknown: Unexpected error — check the Home Assistant logs.

abort.already_configured: This OpenClaw gateway is already configured.

data_description.session_key: The OpenClaw session key to route messages to. Leave blank to use the auto-created 'homeassistant' session.
data_description.system_prompt: Text prepended to every message sent to OpenClaw. Leave blank to send the user message as-is.

reconnect.name: Reconnect
reconnect.description: Force a reconnect to the OpenClaw gateway.

set_session.name: Set session
set_session.description: Change the active OpenClaw session key at runtime.

session_key.name: Session key
session_key.description: The session key to switch to.
